scope: Whole-document eligibility for the Ancient/Medieval route. Modern books may contain quotations; this decision does not identify those quotations as independent witnesses.
cohort_review: Catalog author and translator records, source title pages, and running text were checked independently of GlossAPI's variety labels. A modern editor alone never makes an ancient text a modern composition. Translations with undated translators require both the explicit source role and diagnostic Modern Greek running-text forms; unresolved cases are quarantined.
